key_insight: VQE benchmarking reveals an accuracy–resource trade-off: ADAPT-VQE approaches UCCSD accuracy with lower overhead, while hardware-efficient ansätze reduce hardware costs but sacrifice accuracy.
engineering_relevance: Choosing a VQE ansatz for near-term quantum hardware requires balancing circuit depth, parameter count, molecular size, and optimization difficulty.
method: Compare UCCSD, fermionic ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA, and Excitation Preserving ansätze.
Benchmark electronic structure calculations for H₂, LiH, and N₂.
Evaluate ground-state energy error, circuit depth, parameter count, and NISQ feasibility.
evidence_signal: Across the tested molecules, ADAPT-VQE delivers accuracy comparable to UCCSD, but its circuit complexity becomes impractical around 10 electrons; hardware-efficient performance depends strongly on molecular size.
watch_item: Lower hardware cost does not guarantee useful accuracy: the Excitation Preserving ansatz fails for N₂, highlighting expressibility and trainability concerns.
paper_title: A Unified Benchmarking Study of Variational Quantum Eigensolver Ansatz for Electronic Structure Problems
